Added export const AUTOMATION_SSE_UNAVAILABLE_REASON to make the platform-unavailable case explicit/documentable (native analog of api/sseClient.ts's unavailable reason); getState()'s 'connected'|'reconnecting' contract is unchanged so the consuming hook is unaffected.
